summary: Iteration 1 (first run). Backend: 13/13 core API tests pass (auth owner/courier/register/me, role enforcement 401/403, businesses+products CRUD/toggle, couriers CRUD+dup/validation, orders create w/ server-computed total, filters, status, assign/unassign, dashboard, courier orders/status restriction, location/online). 3 business-rule edge tests FAIL (no status-transition guards, unavailable products orderable via API). Frontend (390x844 web preview): owner login (incl. wrong-password error), dashboard metrics/businesses/active orders, 4 tabs, Órdenes filter chips, order detail -> advance status -> assign courier sheet -> cancel, Nueva orden (business select, qty-plus, customer fields, total $14.60 correct, validation error, navigates to detail), Gestión add/delete business, business detail add/toggle/delete product, Repartidores add (PIN validation disables save)/delete courier, Mapa web fallback list, courier login -> assigned deliveries -> start/deliver -> delivered history, online switch -> location sheet -> 'Conectarme sin ubicación', session persistence on reload, logout — all WORKING. One intermittent auth race found (logout during initial hydration). Deprecated import detected: expo-router/unstable-native-tabs.

minor.issue: No transition validation: owner can move 'entregado' -> 'nuevo' (or revive 'cancelado'); history gets inconsistent. Verified: returns 200.

Courier can set 'en_camino'/'entregado' on a CANCELLED order still assigned to them (get_order filters only courier_id). Verified: returns 200. Should require current status in nuevo/preparacion/en_camino and not cancelled.
Products with available=false are accepted (only filtered in UI). server.py:447 should add 'available': True to query or reject with 400.
Allows assigning/unassigning couriers on delivered/cancelled orders (UI hides it, API does not).

ui_bugs.issue: Race: on app start AuthProvider renders screens while loading=true with user=null (courier.tsx:116 & (owner)/_layout.tsx only redirect when !loading). If user taps logout before /auth/me resolves, signOut clears token+user, then the pending /auth/me resolves and setUser() re-sets the user -> screen stays on 'Hola, Carlos' with 'Error de conexión' (courier/orders now sent w/o token). Reproduced once after page reload. Fix: render <Loading/> while loading, and ignore /auth/me result if signOut happened (e.g. cancelled flag/ref).

rca_of_issue: Logout race: AuthProvider sets loading=true and starts /auth/me; courier.tsx renders full UI (incl. logout) while loading because redirect only checks !loading. Tapping logout -> signOut removes token & setUser(null); then in-flight /auth/me resolves -> setUser(courier) restores the session in memory without a token -> courier/orders 401 (no unauthorized handler because token absent) -> 'Error de conexión'. Repro: login as courier, reload /courier, tap logout immediately. Mitigation: gate screens on loading and cancel stale hydration result.
